name: Hajun
source:
"This person had a body abnormality: a third eye. Because he was different from the normal, he was abhorred. He was sold for a dirt cheap price to reduce the number of mouths. At that time, there was a rite called "Sokushinbutsu" where a monk would depart from one's life while meditating and become a shintai as a saint mummy. And so that person was dedicated to that rite. Of course, not out of free will. He was only a very young child who could not resist. It was convenient for his buyers. If one takes a different view, his grotesque appearance was adorning, and therefore it was something to celebrate. No one noticed the truth, hidden inside.

He was dropped into a hole. A five-story shrine was built on top of it. That person was buried in the darkness with no one to contact him, with no chance to escape, with no light to touch him. There have been many days, months, and years since he was there... I don't know what sort of law (god) his buyers wished for. However, I can guess their intentions. To create a craving for the outside world. To evocate a curse of grieving to the extent of madness. To establish a hegemony with a heretic law similar to Kodoku or Inugami. And, finally, to repaint all the Twilight's creation.

It should be said that it was so foolish. Why, you ask? Because they misread the true nature of that person. Hajun (me) loved exactly that avidya (silence). The universe, that is complete only by his (mine) existence! Ah, exactly for that reason, I hate you, bastards, who never leave Hajun (me) alone! Therefore, I will find you all. I will undoubtedly crush all of nature!

'Tis is the general principle of the sixth generation, Sinza of the sixth generation!..
'Tis is all the truth of the Sixth Heaven, Hajun!"

Story of Hajun from [url=https://vndb.org/c34807]Nakanoin Reizen[/url].

[Translated from in-game narration]
